scripts.title: AUTO FARM AND AUTO RES* OP
scripts.features:
**⚡ FASTEST AUTO FARM – Difficulty Fling ⚡**

An optimized high-speed autofarm script built specifically for *Difficulty Fling*. This script instantly teleports your character to the launch position, applies a powerful forward force, and continuously farms distance for maximum rewards in the shortest possible time.

### 🔥 Features:

* 🚀 **Instant Teleport to Launch Point**
* 💨 **High-Power Force Boost for Maximum Distance**
* 🔁 **Automatic Respawn & Loop Farming**
* 🧹 **Auto GUI Cleanup** (removes popups, messages, gem notifications, lab quests, etc.)
* 🛡️ **Admin Detection System** – Automatically disables autofarm if a detected admin joins the server
* ⚙️ Fully automated – just execute and farm

Designed for speed, efficiency, and minimal interruption.

Built for: Difficulty Fling

Farm smarter. Farm faster. 💰
scripts.script:
getgenv().autofarm = true

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local MASS_SPAWN_DELETE = {
	"POTATO",
	"LabQuest",
	"PopUps",
	"CashGems",
	"Messages"
}

local ADMINS = {
	-- Devs should never expose admin names in ModuleScripts
	-- also there are players that have BanImmunity, which is... odd?
	
	-- return {"taketheldfs", "malfo232"}
	-- game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").BanImmunity 21.02.2026
	-- they were added as ADMINS too in this table

	"w1zlm",
	"pizz4smoke",
	"thewatchcatviolation",
	"ElectrifiedSun",
	"tr1xist",
	"MrZ13596",
	--------------------------------------
	"taketheldfs",
	"malfo232"
}

local function isAdmin(player)
	return table.find(ADMINS, player.Name) ~= nil
end

local function checkPlayers()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if isAdmin(player) then
			getgenv().autofarm = false
			break
		end
	end
end

local function onPlayerJoin(player)
	if isAdmin(player) then
		getgenv().autofarm = false
	end
end

local function setupCharacter(character)
	if not getgenv().autofarm then return end

    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetPos = Vector3.new(112, 570, 129)
    local stuckPos = Vector3.new(101, 1366, 192)
    
	repeat
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos)
		task.wait(0.1)
	until (stuckPos - root.Position).Magnitude > 100
    
    if root:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyForce") then
		root:FindFirstChildOfClass("BodyForce"):Destroy()
	end

    local BodyForce = Instance.new("BodyForce")
    BodyForce.Force = Vector3.new(0, 2500, 50000)
    BodyForce.Parent = root
    
    while task.wait(0.5) do
        if root.Position.Z >= 60000 then
            character:BreakJoints()
            break
        end
    end 
end

if #Players:GetPlayers() > 1 then
	checkPlayers()
end

for i, v in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetChildren()) do
	if table.find(MASS_SPAWN_DELETE, v.Name) then
		v:Destroy()
	end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(setupCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerJoin)
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)
PlayerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
	repeat task.wait() until v

	if table.find(MASS_SPAWN_DELETE, v.Name) then
		v:Destroy()
	end
end)
